text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion charged through the Shuka
Sho! 
The spectators roared with excitement at 
her joyful running.

During the post-race press conference,
she 
announced that she would proceed to the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup next.
This sent the 
public's attention soaring even higher.

However—the fierce Umamusume bearing 
"Princess" in her name,
Kawakami Princess, 
comes forth with a declaration of war!
The "Princess(?) Showdown" promises to be 
turbulent!
